facts.title: Motion (prev Framer Motion): JavaScript & React animation library
facts.description: Motion (prev Framer Motion) is a fast, production-grade animation library for React, JavaScript and Vue. Build smooth UI animations at a tiny footprint.

research.name: Motion
research.note: Animation library for React, Vue and JavaScript, formerly Framer Motion, with layout, gesture and scroll animations.
unverified: The source is in the public repository motiondivision/motion (MIT, about 34k stars); research that repository instead.

Freemium reflects the paid Motion+ tier linked from the header; the library itself is free and open source. The signature effects are taken from the homepage text, not observed demos beyond the hero particle sphere.
